title: Nium Debuts USDC Funding for Client Payouts
message_html: Nium Debuts USDC Funding for Client Payouts ...
snippet: Cross-border payments company Nium has debuted a stablecoin-focused funding program. USDC funding lets businesses finance their Nium accounts with the USDC stablecoin and pay out in fiat, thus extending the company’s payout network to businesses holding stablecoins, the company announced Thursday (A
